_instructions: PERMANENT release-channel URLs — do NOT change apkUrl / tvApkUrl / desktopUrl / ipaUrl for a routine release. To ship a new build you REPLACE the binary behind each URL and update ONLY the version fields + release notes plus the matching sha256/bytes. Per-platform overrides (tvVersion*, desktopVersion*, iosVersion*) let TV, Windows EXE, and iOS ship on their OWN tracks; when null they fall back to the top-level Android values. ⚠️ Each per-platform versionCode MUST equal the versionCode that platform actually BUILDS with (tvApp/build.gradle.kts for TV, PlatformAppVersion.desktop.kt + composeApp packageVersion for EXE, iosApp/project.yml for iOS) — a mismatch makes that platform show a false 'update available'. AFTER BUILDING, fill in the sha256 + bytes for every platform (empty string / 0 = the app skips integrity verification for that platform until you provide them). Compute with: sha256sum <file>  and  stat --format=%s <file>
tvReleaseNotes: Android TV (TV): v1.52 — Downloads appear the instant you tap Download (live status in the entry, failures land in Failed with the reason), server selector honored with correct region labels, auto-taps restored behind a navigation guard that blocks ad and Play-Store hijacks, and chapters reset between titles.
Android TV (TV): v1.48 — New app icon: neon play button wrapped in film strips

Android TV (TV): Multi-currency paywall — plans are priced in your currency (NGN, USD, GBP or EUR) and Flutterwave charges that exact amount; the currency is auto-detected and can be switched with the currency chips
Android TV (TV): New App Settings on the You screen — switch the app language (16 languages or follow the device) and toggle server selectors; both are remembered
Android TV (TV): Simpler AI plan — a single 'AI Creator' tier (20 creations/mo, up to 5 fused sources) quoted in your local currency instead of hardcoded naira prices
Android TV (TV): TV web players now load premium prices from the server so the quoted amount always matches the charge
desktopReleaseNotes: Windows (EXE): v1.46 — Parallel stream resolution and multi-tier server failover
Windows (EXE): Episodic download management and updated scrapers
iosReleaseNotes: iOS (IPA): v1.47 — New watchable home feed: learned 'Recommended For You', 'Latest', and 15 genre rows (Action, Horror, Supernatural, Comedy, Thriller…)
iOS (IPA): Home now lists only watchable video — novels, manga and comics plus the old media dividers are gone
iOS (IPA): Direct streams now play through AVPlayer with a 90-second forward buffer instead of a WebView, greatly reducing rebuffering
iOS (IPA): Fixed 'Continue from where I stopped' hanging on load instead of playing
iOS (IPA): More reliable downloads — files now stream straight to disk, verify HTTP status, fall back to the backend proxy, and bundle fMP4 init segments for offline playback
releaseNotes: Android: version 1.52 — Playback overhaul: the server selector is always honored, titles can never play the wrong show (region + title verification), the player opens instantly, Nebula starts itself with an honest "Starting stream..." status, dead Pulsar/Comet providers auto-switch to Nebula, ad and Play-Store redirect hijacks are blocked, one failed server no longer freezes the rest, and stale episodes can no longer leak between titles.
Android: version 1.48 — New app icon: neon play button wrapped in film strips
Android: Multi-currency paywall — choose NGN, USD, GBP or EUR, see real local prices, and pay via Flutterwave in that same currency (auto-detected from your region, switchable any time)
Android: New language setting in the You tab — pick from 16 languages or follow the device language; the choice is remembered across restarts
Android: New 'Show server selectors' toggle in the You tab — opt-in manual streaming-server picker on detail screens (off by default; the app still auto-picks the best server)
Android: Simpler AI plan — a single 'AI Creator' tier (20 creations/mo, up to 5 fused sources) priced in your currency instead of hardcoded naira prices
